ideas.pitch: A localized energy demand and solar generation forecasting tool built using Poisson regression and historical University of Michigan utility data to predict peak campus grid loads.
ideas.title: Ann Arbor Campus Microgrid Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact engineering pattern of the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner by applying rigorous statistical forecasting rather than generic ML.

ideas.pitch: An investigative compliance platform mapping financial transactions and shipping logistics across Midwest manufacturing hubs to flag illicit supply chain funding using LightGBM.
ideas.title: Midwest Supply Chain AML Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models similar to the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent monitoring platform that ingests public sensor logs from the Great Lakes basin, runs RAG-based analysis, and triggers automated alerts for environmental anomalies.
ideas.title: Great Lakes Water Quality Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines multi-agent student support architecture and RAG pipelines seen in the GreenNovation Hackathon winning project.

ideas.pitch: A personalized meal planning assistant that cross-references local Ann Arbor farmers market inventory with user dietary requirements to generate hyper-local nutritional recommendations.
ideas.title: Local Farm-to-Table Nutrition AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning concept from the Hour Hackathon by pivoting general nutrition into a locally grounded utility.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent marketplace for student organizations to buy and sell event services with trustless USDC escrow payments settled on Base.
ideas.title: Autonomous Campus Event Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning architecture of the Synthesis Hackathon by implementing functional agent-to-agent payments.
